title: Lecture 10 — linear transformations and geometry
summary: Recover a map from basis images and interpret its matrix as a geometric operation.
body:
Authored study companion based on the published lecture plan and module scope, rechecked 17 November. This is not a transcript or a claim about unpublished classroom coverage.

Recognise linear maps and build their standard matrices from basis-vector images.

Use the linked module reading guide for textbook preparation and workshop exercises.
